meta.current_summary_basis: Canonical records, aliases, clusters and ST; bounded research acceptance in TODO.md. Editorial reconciliation is not a new source retrieval.
meta.historical_sections_rule: Dated refresh/screen sections preserve their original counts, open states and source coverage; current_corpus, current_curation, novelty and remaining_gates describe the current cut. Follow the linked living audit for later dispositions.

summary_reconciliation.reason: Current summary headers were not updated after later canonical additions. Recounted from the current registry; no new primary-source verification or change to source cards.
summary_reconciliation.boundary: Dated historical screens retain their original sample sizes and limitations. Author acceptance of EVD-05 does not approve future protocols or replace the supervisor decision.

schema_2_completeness.policy: every nullable scientific field has a terminal resolution
schema_2_completeness.important_boundary: terminal absence documents missing evidence; it does not invent a fact

findings: S738 provides a unified adult Drosophila brain-and-cord structural substrate.
S739 provides connectome-constrained whole-brain dynamics fitted to calcium recordings.
S740 provides a VNC dynamic-simulation precedent with experimental motor-pathway validation.
None of S738-S740 validates nociception-to-human transfer, an ECAP observation model, or SCS clinical response.

clusters.multiple_membership_policy: explicit rationale; membership is navigation, not independent evidence

novelty.reason: Author accepted a bounded PA-08 cut on 2026-10-01 for the IPR. Saturation remains false (STOP-UNSATURATED); worldwide absence, priority and patentability are not established.

scientific_boundaries: A Drosophila simulation label is not subjective human pain.
The fly nervous system is not a direct digital twin of the human spinal cord.
ECAP is neural recruitment and not a direct pain measure.
Clinical SCS-response prediction requires patient-linked longitudinal outcomes.
remaining_gates: EXP-01 through EXP-05: future experimental protocols/execution outside the current literature-research stage
CON-05: separate supervisor decision not received
REL-01 and REL-02: scientific release remains dependent on the experiment and supervisor gates

canonical_identifier_deduplication.policy: one canonical record per normalized DOI; historical IDs resolve through aliases

connectome_prior_art_refresh.control_design_change: replace naive random-connectome control with degree-preserving rewired ensembles trained from shared initialization

crossref_metadata_refresh.boundary: Crossref confirms bibliography only; it does not upgrade full-text validation.

priority_full_text_refresh.scope: publisher full-text extraction for priority human validation records

ecap_scs_review.finding: synthetic ECAP classification and artifact-removal pretraining are disclosed in patent prior art; no Drosophila-to-ECAP/SCS direct analogue was found in this pass

closed_loop_model_review.finding: rat neural-classifier-to-SCS closed-loop prior art exists, but it does not implement Drosophila connectome transfer, ECAP formation or human validation

human_generalization_review.finding: human cross-subject baselines exist, but their targets and access levels differ; none validates Drosophila-to-ECAP-to-SCS transfer

pain_baseline_review.finding: controlled pain, chronic-pain status and fly protective behavior remain distinct target constructs

pain_framework_review.finding: pain constructs and measurement layers must not be treated as interchangeable

neuromodulation_patent_review.finding: several component-level analogues narrow novelty, but patents provide no empirical Drosophila-to-ECAP-to-SCS transfer validation

remaining_metadata_review.finding: all remaining metadata-only records now have either source-specific terminal access boundaries or an upgraded evidence status

ecap_scs_measurement_audit.finding: ECAP waveform and dose are kept separate from pain and clinical response; all dimensions are terminally resolved with primary locators.

drosophila_connectome_audit.finding: Anatomy, dynamics and biological comparators explicitly separated.

synthetic_domain_audit.finding: Unlabeled adaptation, fold leakage, split unit and independent external test separated.

ns06_prior_art_audit.finding: Eight analogue mechanisms compared with S149; no indexed forward citation found at this cutoff, with explicit index-coverage limit. S088 full methods and S759 real-label protocol remain unresolved.

scs_outcome_audit.finding: No study's ECAP, EEG/MEG/radiomics and clinical outcome roles are conflated.

source_access_consistency.rule: Flag, but do not automatically rewrite, a source with full_text_status=checked and access_status unavailable/unavailable_after_search. An archived full text can have a blocked live owner route.
source_access_consistency.boundary: This consistency screen is not a claim that every remaining card is erroneous; inspect each full-text provenance and live versus archived access before changing status.

current_curation.author_review_scope: Delegated EVD-05 acceptance of bounded evidence conclusions on 2026-09-30; future substantive evidence changes and experiment proposals still require review. This does not approve the topic or establish GO.

remaining_blockers: No open human dataset linking SCS/ECAP to a prespecified clinical pain outcome with confirmed reuse permission was located in the checked routes (STOP-H3-A).
Exact upstream release lineage of the four processed S740 VNC matrices remains unconfirmed.
No evidence validates transfer from a Drosophila simulator to human pain or SCS outcomes.
Bounded PA-08 search is accepted for the IPR, but saturation, worldwide absence, priority and patentability are not established (STOP-UNSATURATED).
G0 remains G0_REVISE; delegated EVD-05 acceptance does not replace a separate supervisor decision or future protocol review.
